reviews.title: Ads???

reviews.title: Worst Email App I’ve Ever Used
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this app has been one of the worst email experiences I’ve ever had. The app is extremely slow, emails often fail to open properly, and many actions redirect straight to advertisements instead of functioning as expected.

On top of that, having to pay for an app that performs this poorly is very disappointing. Basic features like opening emails should work smoothly, but instead the app constantly lags and wastes time.

Overall, the performance, reliability, and user experience are far below the standard expected for an App Store app. I would not recommend this app to anyone, and I honestly believe Apple should review whether apps with this level of quality belong on the App Store.
